title: Define conjunctions of more than 256 operands in chunks in Lean
summary: A conjunction of more than 256 operands, including the pairs of a wide distinct, is now defined in Lean as a chain of 32-operand chunks with one projection theorem each. The QF_UF sokoban benchmark, which ran out of heartbeats at 40.1 MB of Lean, now exports to 8.5 MB and verifies with no trust setting changed.
